page0.text:
"Emiya, are you okay...!?"
As soon as Tohsaka runs up to me, she takes my hand.

page1.text:
"W-we have to stop the bleeding...! Do you have anything to wrap around it...!?"
"Uh... Oh, here's a handkerchief. It's probably clean since Sakura gave it to me."

page2.text: "Ugh, great minds think alike. But it's better than nothing. We can make do with my towel and that."

page3.text:
She takes my pulse while murmuring what sounds like a spell.
...It must be a styptic and a painkiller, since my right arm feels a bit better.
Tohsaka diligently puts the handkerchief on my wound and wraps my right arm with the towel.

page4.text:
"..."
Seeing her profile again confirms it.
Tohsaka is as good a person as she is beautiful.
Up until three days ago, she was just someone that I admired from afar and thought of as a model student.
Now that I've had a chance to get to know her, she's definitely far from that pedestal, but the person beneath it all is still worthy of admiration.

page5.text:
My heart's throbbing.
My pulse is racing.
Tohsaka is a good person, she's so close to me right now that we're about to touch, and she's so beautiful that I can forgive her for everything that's happened until now... I can't think straight...

page6.text:
"All right, this should be good for first aid.
...So, what was she? I tried to back you up since you were in a horrible situation once I caught up."
"I don't know either. I followed them here and got attacked."

page7.text:
I concisely explain what happened.
...I decide not to say anything about seeing Shinji.
It could have been my imagination and even if it was him, I have no proof that he's connected with that Servant.

page8.text:
"..."
"Don't make that face. I couldn't tell who she was, but she's a Servant, right? Then, that means there's a Master other than us."

page9.text:
"...Yeah. I knew there was another Master, but they finally made a move."
Tohsaka sighs.
...Hm.
It seems like Tohsaka had already realized about the third Master a while ago.

page10.text:
"...Hm?"
In that case, is that Master the one who attacked the female student...?
"Wait, Tohsaka. What happened to that girl...!?"

page11.text:
"She's doing better. She's sleeping in the nurse's office, so she should be all right."
"...Okay. That's good."
I sigh with relief.
...Then, that means that all pressing matters have been solved.
So, all that's left is...

page12.text:
"What? W-what's with the look? J-just so you know, I wouldn't do anything like what you're thinking!"
I don't know how she misunderstood.
Tohsaka sometimes makes some weird misunderstandings.

page13.text:
"Hey, I know that. Of course you wouldn't do such a thing. What I want to ask is if you want to continue. Do you want to keep fighting or not?"
...
Hearing that, Tohsaka freezes.

page14.text:
...I wonder how long that lasted.
Tohsaka glares at me once...
And then hangs her head in defeat.

page15.text:
"..."
I mean, okay...
But it sure is uncomfortable with you making a face like that so close to me.

page16.text:
"Tohsaka? Um, so what are you going to do?"
"We're done here. This is it for today. I'm not in the mood anymore, and now I owe you for another thing again."
She stands up and dusts her knees.

page17.text:
"Let's go. I'm sure it hurts, but bear with it until we get to my place."
Tohsaka offers me a hand.
"...?"
I tilt my head and look into Tohsaka's eyes.

page18.text:
"I said we're going to my place. You can't heal that wound by yourself."
"Oh... Well, that's true, but why?"

page19.text:
"There's no reason.
You'll die from necrosis if we leave that wound be. It'll be my fault if you can't move your arm anymore."
"Huh... Huh?"
No, wait.
I don't get it at all.

page20.text:
Tohsaka's house is in the residential area on the other side of town.
There are Western-style houses near the top of the residential area, but I've never been there.
I know of the area, but I don't have any firsthand experience. It's basically unknown territory.

page21.text:
Then...
This is the famous Western-style mansion at the top of the hill... The home of Tohsaka, a mage with a prestigious lineage.

page22.text:
...
I look up at the mansion, dumbfounded.
...Well, I'm used to seeing things like this because of Shinji's house, but this has its own aesthetic.
